Press Release titled "AXISCADES Technologies to acquire Cloud Wave Technologies, Accelerating Entry into Aerospace Manufacturing"

Axiscades Technologies Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve raising of funds by way of issuance of Secured, Unlisted, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) for a value upto Rs. 200 crores.
